digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter user identity model / assignee resolution
propositions: Jira Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, requiring separate identity handling in the adapter.
Define a UserIdentityModel Protocol with resolve and to_payload, implemented by AccountIdIdentity ({accountId}) for Cloud and NameIdentity ({name}) for Data Center.
NameIdentity performs a real lookup against DC's user-search endpoint and receives its resolver via explicit constructor injection, not getattr discovery, so its authoritative branch is reachable.
A permanently non-authoritative assignee resolution causes the outbound diff to re-emit assignee changes that never converge (assignee-diff churn).
An unresolvable assignee must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning a non-authoritative value.

AC4's literal grep for _assignee_resolver returning nothing is not satisfiable within scope; it is narrowed to the identity models containing no getattr-discovered collaborators, with core attribute-injection removal filed as follow-up work.
